verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that brings Statsig into AI clients like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code, so users can ask questions, explore experiments, and access their Statsig data in natural language. That support depends on an external AI client, and the documented scope covers querying and exploring rather than operating the product (creating or modifying gates and experiments). The separate Docs MCP server only reads documentation. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language assistant, evidence that natural-language commands can perform write/management actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
